Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4136, claude-fable-5-2, mkinney / .claude-team2 seat; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Needs changes before merge.** One finding, in the PR body only. The code, the tests and the mutation checks are clean. This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes the toolpath and the posted G-code of a Contour that has protected items.

## What looks good

- With no protected item, each `*_avoid` entry calls the plain generator. `empty_avoid_matches_plain_contour_paths_exactly` and `contour::contour_without_do_not_touch_keeps_same_toolpath` pin this. The example catalog suites and `golden_cl` did not move.
- Each avoid generator ends in `finalize_avoid` (`contour_avoid_clip.rs`). It runs the full-tool check `AvoidSpec::hits_named` on the final moves and refuses by item name. The clip logic is thus not the only guard.
- A clipped ring under control compensation is refused by name. It is not cut as open pieces.
- The refactors of `contour_open_run` and `contour_open_run_sided` (`open_run_ride`, `sided_run_ride`) keep the plain path the same.
- No new crate dependency. No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!()` in the new source files. Each new module has its provenance line. Each new source file is below 400 lines.
- The decision entry `docs/decisions/3344-contour-do-not-touch.md` records the skip-with-note choice and its precedent.

## Results merged with main (locally, on host m3)

Trial merge of `c50a967e8` with upstream/main `bd467a0cc`: clean, no conflict. `mergeable`: MERGEABLE.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (the full plan, run in parts with `--only`) | 339 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled |
| - motion build and 100 motion suites, with `avoid_contour` | pass (3 of 3 pins) |
| - app build, `app suites: lib` and 226 app suites | pass |
| - `app suites: do_not_touch` | pass, 11 of 11 (the 4 `contour::*` pins included) |
| - `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `golden_cl`, `solid_law_goldens`, `mcp_doc_drift` | pass |
| - ui build and 9 ui suites; `ui suites: lib` | pass, 1700 passed, 0 failed (the 2 UI pins included) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light` (release) | 6 steps, 0 failed |

Extra suites run: none are owed. The diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no import code.

Heavy lanes: not run. AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" gives a `P3` PR no heavy step. No heavy record names this head.

Goldens moved: none. The diff has no `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file. This agrees with the body.

## Mutations (run by the reviewer, each restored after the run)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| M1: `do_not_touch_applies` without `OpType::Contour` | red: 3 `contour::*` app pins fail. `contour_without_do_not_touch_keeps_same_toolpath` stays green. This agrees with the body. |
| M2: `trim_ends` does nothing (no `END_TRIM` step) | red: `contour_avoid_closed_partial_tabs_inside_whole_and_open_stay_clear` fails at `avoid_contour.rs:178`. |
| R1 (reviewer's own): `emit_band_avoid` clips against an empty keep-out | red: the same pin fails. The generator refuses with `cannot cut clear of protected 'Do not touch' protected block (Flute, 2.000 mm short of 1.00 mm clearance)`. The final verify catches a ring that is not clipped. |

The tree was the PR head again after the last run (`git status` clean, `HEAD^1` = `c50a967e8`).

A reviewer probe (a temporary test, not committed) ran `contour_avoid` with Keep down links on 3 levels, for 4 protected shapes, 2 leads and 2 sides. No case gave a sloped feed between levels: each link between levels lifted.

## Requested before merge

1. **PR body: the line `Process change: yes` is missing.** Class: PR body law. The PR changes `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:173`, and `.claude/skills/` is a process file (AGENTS.md "Process changes bump `PROCESS_VERSION` and are announced"). Add the line `Process change: yes` to the body. Do not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. One rule for the class: before a PR is opened, run `git diff --name-only upstream/main...HEAD` and add the line when a path is a process file. This fix changes the body only. No new commit is necessary.

## Questions and notes (not blocking)

- `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:173` now lists `2D Contour`, `2D Offset` and `3D Pocket`. The tool text in `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:51` lists nine kinds. The skill row was not current before this PR. A follow-up can align it.
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:712` and `crates/app/src/operation/contour_sketch.rs:203` find a blocked ring by the text of the error message (`starts_with` and `ends_with`). A change of the wording in `finalize_avoid` stops the skip without a compile error. A typed error is safer. Suggested follow-up: `P7`.
- `contour_avoid_emit.rs:107`: on a tabbed level, a clipped ring is cut as open pieces and gets no tabs. The blocked span stays uncut and holds the part. No note tells the user that the tabs are not cut. Suggested follow-up: `P7`.
- `contour_avoid_piece.rs:242`: `push_open_piece` calls `ring_link` for each piece after the first, also for the first piece of a new level. `ring_link` is the link inside one level. The probe above found no sloped feed, because the proof fails across a keep-out. A pin for this case is a possible follow-up.
- `crates/motion/tests/avoid_contour.rs` has no `Gate map:` line. Its sibling `avoid_engrave.rs` has one.
- `crates/app/tests/do_not_touch/contour.rs` has 414 lines, and `generate.rs` grows by about 76 lines (it was above the limit before).
- The commit `1993c0cf1` has the type `wip`, which is not a Conventional Commits type. It cannot change now (no force-push).
- Screenshots: the diff in `crates/ui` changes tests only. The visible change is that the Boundary group of a Contour shows "Pick protected" in place of the note. The two UI pins assert it. Screenshots are not requested.
- The tilted (3+2) case is tracked in #4131, as the body says.

The label is `needs-rework`. The PR stays a draft. After the body has the line, comment "Addressed" on this PR. A re-review of the same head then checks only that line.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the one finding of the review of `c50a967e8be7ce8452d15699bb58057d1a293734`.

1. **PR body: the line `Process change: yes` was missing.** The body now has the line `Process change: yes`, above the `Changelog:` line. The reason is the change to `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`. `git diff --name-only upstream/main...HEAD` shows no other process file. The PR does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.

Evidence: `gh pr view 4136 -R NeoTech/Camcraft --json body --jq .body | grep -n "^Process change: yes$"` gives one line.

This fix changes the body only. There is no new commit and no push. The head is the same: `c50a967e8be7ce8452d15699bb58057d1a293734`. No test pins a body line, and no gate ran again, because the tree did not change.

The notes that do not block are not changed in this round.

Please review the same head again.
